steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text:
(crouched at the old hearth, sleeves pushed up)
Walls that hold, a roof that keeps the rain off the soup. You have done more today than the crown managed in nine years.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: That was Tharr's doing. I only carried the stone.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Carrying the stone is most of it. Ask any mason.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text:
(he peers up the chimney)
And this — this is a proper hearth under all the soot. The draw is honest. Give me a few days and it will feed everyone here.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text:
(he stands, brushing ash from his hands)
Get some rest. Whatever this place is going to be, it starts tomorrow. Tonight it can simply be standing.
Far off in the dark, a long, low howl. Held too long to be a dog. Closer than anyone would like.
